fixes.fix: Explained "The season officially ran from 1 November _____ to 30 April 2026, activity began as early "
fixes.text: 1) VERDICT: The answer is 2025. 2) WHY: The 2025–26 Australian region cyclone season officially spans 1 November 2025 to 30 April 2026, with pre-season activity starting in mid-July 2025. 3) TRAPS: Do not confuse the start year with the end year; the season is named by its start year. 4) HOOK: Remember '25 to 26' for the Nov-Apr window. Exam trap: Early July activity is pre-season, not part of the official count.

fixes.fix: Explained "It was the fourth consecutive season to have 5 or more severe tropical cyclones, a streak "
fixes.text: 1) VERDICT: The streak began in 2022-23. 2) WHY: This marks the fourth straight season with five or more severe tropical cyclones, starting from the 2022-23 cycle. 3) TRAPS: Do not confuse the start year with the current season; the timeline is strictly sequential. 4) HOOK: Remember '22-23' as the anchor point for this four-year run. Exam trap: Verify the exact season label, not just the year, to avoid off-by-one errors in consecutive streak questions.
